summary: Removes a collision object node from its type-specific sub-list and recycles it onto a global free list. Maps the top three tag bits (a2[0] >> 29) through a jump table (004B4B34) to a sub-list index 0..3, derives the sub-list base this + 16*(index+7), and walks the sub-list via the next pointers at node+4 until a node whose payload (node+0) equals a2 is found. If found, the node is unlinked (updating sub-list head at base+0, tail at base+4, and the pointer at base+8), the sub-list count at base+12 is decremented, the node's data buffer is freed when the flag byte at node+8 is non-zero, and the node struct itself is freed. ArithmeticComparison_47a0 is called with the object, low byte of a2[0], constant 0, the sub-list index and the low byte of a2[0]. A fresh 12-byte node pointing at a2 is then allocated and prepended to the global free list (dword_8AB700), with dword_8AB704/dword_8AB708 set when the list was empty and dword_8AB70C incremented. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the node is not found.

operations.description: Type-tag dispatch: switch on *a2 >> 29 maps tag values 1, 2/3, 4 and 6 to sub-list indices 0, 1, 2, 3 respectively, defaulting to -1, via the jump table at 004B4B34
Derives the sub-list header offset v5 = 16*(v4+7) inside this (112 for index 0, up to 160 for index 3) and loads the sub-list head pointer this[v5]
If the sub-list head this[v5] is zero the search ends immediately and 0 is returned; otherwise the sub-list is walked
Walks the sub-list following next pointers at node+4 while the payload at node+0 differs from a2; reaching a null next pointer returns 0 (not found)
If the removed node is the pointer stored at sub-list header +8, that header field is updated to the removed node's successor

Unlinks the node: previous node's next (or the sub-list head at base+0 when there is no previous) is set to the removed node's next; if the removed node was the tail (header +4) the tail is set to the previous node
Decrements the sub-list count at header +12
When the flag byte at node+8 is non-zero, FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the node's payload buffer at node+0
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the removed node struct itself
ArithmeticComparison_47a0 called with (this, low byte of a2[0], 0, sub-list index, low byte of a2[0]) as the post-removal metadata/notify step
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper allocates 12 bytes for a replacement free-list node
Initializes the replacement node: data=a2 at node+0, next=0 at node+4, flag byte 0 at node+8
Free-list prepend: when dword_8AB700 (head) is non-null the new node's next is set to it; when the list is empty dword_8AB704 and dword_8AB708 are set to the new node
dword_8AB700 is updated to point at the new node as the free-list head
Increments the free-list node counter dword_8AB70C
Returns 1 after a successful remove-and-recycle, 0 when the target node is absent
